---
title: "Experiment registry"
---

Every experiment registers here **before it runs** — no post-hoc entries.
Rendered from `experiments/registry.yaml` at publish time.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
reg_path <- "../experiments/registry.yaml"
# No registry yet: say so and render nothing else. (knitr::knit_exit() only
# stops AFTER this chunk, so the code below it still ran and failed on the
# missing file, breaking the wiki publish; the claim ledger had the same bug.)
if (!file.exists(reg_path)) {
  cat("*No experiment registry yet — it is seeded with the knowledge base.*\n")
} else {
  reg <- yaml::read_yaml(reg_path)$experiments
  if (length(reg) == 0) {
    cat("*No experiments registered yet. Register each one in",
        "`experiments/registry.yaml` before it runs.*\n")
  } else {
    cat("| Run | Question | Dataset | Primary metric | Status |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
    for (e in reg) {
      cat(sprintf("| `%s` | %s | `%s` | `%s` | **%s** |\n",
                  e$run_id, e$research_question, e$dataset_id,
                  e$metrics$primary, e$status))
    }
  }
}
```
